SERVICE EXPLAINED

What does this service involve?

Email and collaboration problems often affect several workflows at once. A mailbox migration, for example, is also an identity, device and communication project. Discovery should establish who owns the tenant, which subscriptions are in use and which integrations could be affected.

The engagement starts by identifying the business outcome, existing responsibilities and the changes you authorise. HeyDock then confirms suitable delivery capacity, the working window and the evidence needed to complete the task. Related licences, hardware, subscriptions and specialist services are included only where the proposal says so.

PRACTICAL SCOPE

What can be included?

The final statement of work identifies the tasks that apply to your environment.

Tenant and user administration

Agree authorised account administration, group membership and permission changes. Document who can approve new access and how requests are recorded. Do not share administrator credentials through ordinary enquiry forms.

Email and file migration

Map source data, permissions, retention needs and cutover dependencies before moving mailboxes or files. Test a representative migration and reconcile results before the wider change window.

Teams and collaboration

Review meeting, file-sharing and collaboration requirements alongside device and network readiness. Teams telephony is a separate scoped requirement with licensing and connectivity dependencies.

EXAMPLE REQUIREMENT

How a project might work.

A business changing email platforms can begin with an inventory, migration pilot and user communication plan. The agreed scope identifies data that will move, downtime expectations, rollback options and post-migration checks.

PLANNING AND COST

What affects the scope and price?

Cost depends on the number of users, devices or sites; technical complexity; access requirements; delivery hours; travel; and the work needed before and after implementation. Provide relevant system versions and existing supplier responsibilities so the quotation can distinguish labour from licences, equipment and recurring charges.

For a well-defined task, a visit or project quotation may be appropriate. Where important dependencies are unknown, a paid assessment can produce a better implementation scope. Any response, attendance or recovery target must be explicitly agreed; requesting a service does not create an immediate support commitment.

COMMON QUESTIONS

Microsoft 365 support and migration FAQs

Are licences included?+

Licence supply and subscription costs are confirmed separately unless explicitly included in a proposal.

Are you claiming Microsoft partner status?+

No partner accreditation is claimed on this page. Delivery capability and any vendor relationship should be evidenced for the engagement.

What information should we include in an enquiry?+

Describe the objective, location, affected systems, preferred timing and existing support arrangements. Do not send passwords or sensitive business records in the enquiry form.
